title: Lionfish — modifier-only keymaps & mapping reordering
content:
A new feature and polish update to Lionfish, the native Windows desktop keypad and macro interceptor under the JeffersonWM suite, adds support for standalone modifier mappings, interactive keymap reordering, and full dark-theme scrollbar refinement.

Key additions:

  • Modifier-Only Keystrokes: Keypad keys can now be mapped directly to single modifier keys (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, or Win) without requiring an alphanumeric character or secondary target key. Selecting (None) or clicking the new ✕ Clear button binds the modifier cleanly.
  • Hardware Hold-and-Release Interception: Engineered modifier dispatch in the interception engine to mirror physical button states. Holding down a keypad button keeps the modifier key held down in Windows (enabling natural Shift-typing, Ctrl-clicking, and Alt-dragging), and releasing the button immediately lifts the modifier.
  • Interactive Keymap Reordering: Added ▲ and ▼ movement controls directly to each row of the Key Map table. Users can arrange mappings in any sequence, with changes instantly persisted to the active profile in %APPDATA%\Lionfish.
  • Dark Mode & Fluent Scrollbars: Overhauled application styling to eliminate bright light borders and light scrollbars in Dark mode, ensuring full visual consistency across cards, lists, and dialogs.
  • Single-File Authenticode Deployment: Compiled and deployed the updated standalone binary to LocalAppData, signed with development code signing to ensure clean execution alongside desktop shortcut integration.
